verdict.rationale: Productboard doesn't show a native in-app AI assistant/chatbot; instead it exposes an MCP server so external AI agents (e.g., Claude, coding agents) can perform actions like adding features, rescheduling initiatives, or updating prioritization fields (productboard-docs-10, -11, -12, -13). This satisfies 'delegate tasks to AI' in spirit but not as a built-in, native assistant embedded in the Productboard UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party in-product AI assistant/chat interface, hands-on proof of the MCP-driven delegation working reliably, and independent corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
